title: From Facts to Insights: A Study on the Generation and Evaluation of Analytical Reports for Deciphering Earnings Calls

bias_targets.methodology: Testing LLM evaluators in a preference-based ranking scenario by presenting candidates in both possible orderings to determine if the models disproportionately favor the first displayed option.
Comparing LLM evaluation preferences between human-authored reference reports and machine-generated reports to detect if the models inherently favor generated text regardless of presentation order.
